verses.raw: Men are in charge of women<sup foot_note=254190>1</sup> by [right of] what Allāh has given one over the other and what they spend [for maintenance] from their wealth. So righteous women are devoutly obedient, guarding in [the husband's] absence what Allāh would have them guard.<sup foot_note=254188>2</sup> But those [wives] from whom you fear arrogance<sup foot_note=254191>3</sup> - [first] advise them; [then if they persist], forsake them in bed; and [finally], strike them [lightly].<sup foot_note=254189>4</sup> But if they obey you [once more], seek no means against them. Indeed, Allāh is ever Exalted and Grand.
